records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue decreased by 6.8 percent in the second quarter of 2023 compared to the same period in 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This decrease resulted primarily from decreases in fuel surcharge revenue, resulting from lower diesel fuel prices, and decreases in shipments and tonnage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 82.7 percent in the second quarter of 2023 compared to 80.4 percent in the second quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decreases in revenue were partially offset by improved revenue per shipment, excluding fuel surcharge, due to pricing and changes in business mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $120.3 million for the second quarter of 2023 compared to $146.0 million for the second quarter of 2022.
